module: Manager of the layers of a Master Spline. A layer links the Master Spline to a child spline of another tool (mesh, assembly, decal, road, tree) and sends it a laterally offset copy of the discretized geometry, simplified by RDP (tolerance 0.25). This module creates, updates, deletes, copies and (de)serializes the layers.
notes: A layer contains: name, id (UUID), isDirty, isLink, linkType, linkedSplineId, linkedSplineName, isFlip, isTrackWidth, position (lateral offset, multiplied by the local half-width).
If the Master Spline has fewer than 2 nodes, the linked spline receives empty arrays so that its objects are cleaned up.
If isFlip is true, the simplified geometry is sent in reverse order.
addNewLayer does not set isTrackWidth (nil, hence false); deserializeLayer forces it to a boolean.

Slider defaults (getSliderDefaults): defaultPaintMargin 0, defaultLateralPosition 0, defaultDOI 20, defaultTerraMargin 1, defaultTerraFalloff 3, defaultTerraRoughness 0, defaultTerraScale 0, defaultTerraSmooth 2, defaultBankStrength 0.5, defaultAutoBankFalloff 0.6.

getSliderDefaults.desc: Returns the table of the slider default values, for the tool's interface.

deepCopyLayer.desc: Deep copy of a layer (via string.buffer encode/decode).

deepCopyAllLayers.desc: Deep copy of an array of layers.

updateAllLayers.desc: Sends the Master Spline's geometry to the linked spline of each layer, dirty or not, and sets isDirty back to false.

masterSpline.desc: Master Spline (nodes, divPoints, divWidths, binormals, normals, layers, isLoop, isConformToTerrain).

updateOnlyDirtyLayers.desc: Like updateAllLayers but only for layers with isDirty true.

removeLayer.desc: Deletes the layer at index idx; if it has a linked spline, that spline is deleted in its tool.

removeAllLayers.desc: Deletes all the layers and their linked splines.

addNewLayer.desc: Adds a "New Layer N" layer (generated UUID, isDirty true, unlinked, default link type = mesh, default position).

spline.desc: Master Spline that receives the layer.

serializeLayer.desc: Converts a layer to a plain table (name, id, isLink, linkType, linkedSplineId, linkedSplineName, isFlip, isTrackWidth, position), without the internal buffers.

deserializeLayer.desc: Rebuilds a layer from serialized data; isDirty is set to true, a UUID is generated if id is missing, defaults otherwise.
